title: Common definitions
description: PRELIMINARY. Describes the formats as the app uses them today; it isn't a spec to design against, and it changes whenever development needs it. Background and decisions: docs/Schema Notes.md. Shared by playbook.schema.json, basic-moves.schema.json and hunter.schema.json.

id.description: An id: lowercase, digits, underscores. Usually left out: auto-assigned from `name` ("Could've Been Worse" -> couldve_been_worse).

reference.description: A reference: `@` + a path of ids. Root-relative unless the first segment is a file id (`@basic_moves.use_magic.heal`, `@the_expert.haven`). Special: `@this` (the object it's written in), `@textbox` (free text), `@*.moves` (that list in every other playbook), `@...` (in an on_edit / on_view array: the object's own value), `@.name` (escape hatch for a relative name that collides with a file id).

plainText.description: A plain value, not a reference: anything not starting with `@` (a plain-string option, a look option, a history option).

markdown.description: Display text: a markdown subset plus [[wikilinks]] and <span class='...'> (src/Markdown.js).

paragraphs.description: One paragraph as a string, or several as an array of strings.

schemaVersion.description: 0.1.yyyy.mm.dd: the date of the last breaking change, plus .1, .2... if it breaks again on a day it was already pushed.

ratings.description: A ratings line: one value per rating.

tags.description: Gear and attack tags, one word each: "2-harm", "close", "+1-armour".

chooseRule.description: One `choose` rule: where to choose from (`from`, default `@this`) and exactly one verb with its count. pick: add it; cross: strike it out, still visible; remove: undo an earlier pick; attach: attach this option to one of your picks, without picking it again. `min` (default: the count) allows fewer; `limits` sets min / max per sub-list.

choose.description: One rule, or several (improvements that do more than one thing).

grant.description: What you gain outright: a reference or several. Granting a list grants everything in it.

effect.description: A fixed effect: a rating change (respecting `max`), luck (one-off, when taken), or marking this object's picks of basic moves as advanced.

details.description: Display-only sub-items, chosen during play rather than when building the hunter (Could've Been Worse's options, Dark Past's questions).

pageOverride.description: on_edit / on_view: keys that replace the object's own on that page. In an array, `@...` stands for the object's own value.
